items.title: 4.2 Biology mein bonds ki qismein (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.2, printed pages 93-94.

blocks.text: Mukhtalif qisam ke bonds aur interactions (aapas ke taalluqat) biological molecules ki structure (banawat) aur function (kaam) mein bohat aham kirdar ada karte hain.

Carbon organic molecules ka bunyadi element hai. Yeh tetravalent hai (yani chaar bonds bana sakta hai) aur H, O, N, P aur S jaise bohat se doosre elements se react kar sakta hai. Carbon aur hydrogen ka bond (C-H bond) cell ki activities ke liye chemical energy ka zariya (source) hai. Glycosidic linkages mein carbon aur oxygen ka jor complex carbohydrate molecules ko stability (mazbooti) deta hai. Amino acids ke jor mein carbon nitrogen se mil kar peptide bonds banata hai aur yun proteins bante hain. Proteins bohat aham hain kyun ke un ki structure aur functions mein bohat diversity (rangarangi, farq) hai.

Covalent bonds tab bante hain jab do atoms electrons share karte hain (Figure 4.1). Yeh bonds aksar proteins aur nucleic acids jaise organic molecules mein milte hain aur molecules ko mazboot rakhte hain.

blocks.alt: Do atoms, A (laal) aur B (neela), har ek ka nucleus aur electrons ka ek shell; har ek ke paas ek akela (unpaired) valence electron hai. Teer covalent molecule ki taraf jata hai jahan dono shells ek doosre par charh kar electrons ka joda share karte hain. Labels: Unpaired Valence Electrons, Atom 1, Atom 2, Sharing of Available Valence Electrons, Covalent Molecule.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.1: Do atoms ke darmiyan covalent bond (kitab ki Figure 4.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ionic bonds tab bante hain jab ek atom electron de deta hai (aur positive ion yani cation ban jata hai) aur doosra atom woh electron le leta hai (aur negative ion yani anion ban jata hai) (Figure 4.2). In ulte charge wale ions ke darmiyan electrostatic attraction (bijli ki kashish) hi ionic bond hai. Ionic bonds solid (thos) halat mein kafi mazboot hote hain aur zyada tar sodium chloride jaise inorganic molecules mein bante hain.

blocks.alt: Sodium atom (electrons 2, 8, 1) aur chlorine atom (2, 8, 7) apne shells ke saath; ek mura hua teer sodium ka bahar wala akela electron chlorine tak le jata hai. Reaction ke teer ke baad: Na+ (shells 2, 8) aur Cl- (shells 2, 8, 8). Labels: Na, Cl, Sodium atom, Chlorine atom, Na+, Cl-, Sodium chloride.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.2: Sodium aur chlorine atoms ke darmiyan ionic bond (kitab ki Figure 4.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Hydrogen bonds ek hydrogen atom aur ek electronegative atom (electron ko zyada khenchne wala atom, jaise oxygen ya nitrogen) ke darmiyan kamzor kashish (attraction) hain. Yeh bonds proteins aur nucleic acids jaise bare molecules ki structure qaim rakhne mein, aur DNA replication (DNA ki copy banna) jaise biological processes mein aham hain.

blocks.alt: Pani ke paanch molecules: bara laal O aur do chhote neele H. Dashed lakeerein ek molecule ke H ko saath wale molecule ke O se jorti hain. Har O par delta manfi (delta minus) aur jure hue H par delta musbat (delta plus) likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.3: Pani ke molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bond (kitab ki Figure 4.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Hydrophobic interactions (pani se door rehne wale taalluqat) nonpolar molecules aur polar molecules (jaise pani) ke darmiyan hote hain. Pani wale mahol mein nonpolar molecules aapas mein ikatthe ho jate hain taake pani ke molecules se kam se kam mil sakein. Yeh amal proteins ki folding (tah ho kar shakal banna) aur cell membranes mein lipid bilayers (lipid ki dohri teh) banne ke liye bohat zaroori hai.

Hydrophilic interactions (pani se jurne wale taalluqat) polar molecules aur pani ke molecules ke darmiyan hote hain. Inhi ki wajah se polar aur ionic compounds pani mein dissolve (hal) hote hain. Yeh interactions nutrient transport (ghiza ki tarseel) aur cells ke andar chemical reactions jaise biological processes mein madad karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si qisam ka bond DNA ke do strands ko jore rakhta hai, aur yeh bond kamzor hone ke bawajood molecule kyun nahin bikharta?
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bonds dono strands ko jore rakhte hain. Har hydrogen bond kamzor hai, magar DNA ki lambai mein yeh bohat zyada tadaad mein hain, aur har strand khud mazboot covalent bonds se bana hai. Is liye double helix mazboot bhi hai aur replication ke waqt khul bhi sakta hai.

items: Carbon tetravalent hai; C-H bond energy ka zariya hai, glycosidic linkages mein C-O jor carbohydrates ko mazboot karta hai, aur C-N peptide bonds proteins banate hain.

Covalent bond: electrons share hote hain (mazboot, organic molecules). Ionic bond: electron ek atom se doosre ko jata hai (cation aur anion, NaCl). Hydrogen bond: H aur O ya N ke darmiyan kamzor kashish (proteins, DNA).
Hydrophobic interactions nonpolar molecules ko pani se door ikattha karte hain (protein folding, lipid bilayers); hydrophilic interactions polar aur ionic compounds ko pani mein hal karte hain.
